Macrons

Consonantal i

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play · Conversation, family & daily routines

look for verb

also seek

classical

quaerō, quaerere, quaesīvī, quaesītum

verb, third conjugation

seek or ask

Eāmus thēsaurum quaesītum! uses the supine of purpose after a verb of motion.

Examples

  • Ubi est? Quaerāmus.

    Where is it? Let’s look.composed

  • Eāmus thēsaurum quaesītum!

    Let’s go look for treasure!composed

Other words

  • quaeritāre — look for

    also used · classical · Plaut.; Ter.

See also hide, hide and seek, find, ask, search, quest.
